rules.rationale: The Universal Protocol requires a preprocedure verification process to ensure the correct procedure, patient, and site.
rules.citation: UP.01.01.01 - Conduct a preprocedure verification process.
rules.citation_paraphrase: UP.01.01.01 - Conduct a preprocedure verification process.
rules.citation_verbatim_excerpt: ### Introduction to the Universal Protocol for Preventing Wrong Site, Wrong Procedure, and Wrong Person Surgery™ The Universal Protocol applies to all surgical and nonsurgical invasive procedures.

@graph.name: Implement a preprocedure process to verify the correct procedure, for the correct patient, at the correct site

rules.rationale: The preprocedure verification process involves checking relevant documents and information.
rules.citation: UP.01.01.01 EP 1 - Implement a preprocedure process to verify the correct procedure, for the correct patient, at the correct site.

rules.rationale: The preprocedure verification process involves verifying the availability of required items using a standardized list.
rules.citation: UP.01.01.01 EP 2 - Identify the items that must be available for the procedure and use a standardized list to verify their availability.

@graph.name: Verify relevant documents and information are available prior to the start of the procedure, correctly identified, labeled, and matched to patient identifiers.
Verify availability of required items using a standardized list.

rules.rationale: The standardized list should include items like history and physical, consent form, nursing assessment, preanesthesia assessment, labeled diagnostic results (radiology images/scans, pathology/biopsy reports), required blood products, implants, devices, and special equipment.
rules.citation: UP.01.01.01 EP 2 - Identify the items that must be available for the procedure and use a standardized list to verify their availability. At a minimum, these items include...

@graph.name: Verify availability of standardized list items (e.g., history and physical, consent form, nursing assessment, preanesthesia assessment, labeled diagnostic results, required blood products, implants, devices, special equipment).
